preReview.title: Seattle 'still standing' despite winless MLS stretch, says Schmetzer
preReview.description: The Seattle Sounders are without a win in their last five MLS fixtures, and they travel to face the Portland Timbers next.

preReview.title: Schmetzer asegura que Seattle “sigue en pie” pese a la mala racha sin ganar en la MLS
preReview.description: Los Seattle Sounders encadenan cinco partidos sin ganar en la MLS y ahora visitan a los Portland Timbers.

preReview.title: Seattle ancora in piedi nonostante la serie senza vittorie in MLS, dice Schmetzer
preReview.description: I Seattle Sounders sono senza vittorie da cinque partite di MLS e ora fanno visita ai Portland Timbers.

preReview.title: Seattle segue de pé apesar de sequência sem vitórias na MLS, diz Schmetzer
preReview.description: O Seattle Sounders está há cinco jogos sem vencer na MLS e agora vai encarar o Portland Timbers fora de casa.

preReview.title: Seattle « toujours debout » malgré une série sans victoire en MLS, assure Schmetzer
preReview.description: Les Seattle Sounders restent sur cinq matches de MLS sans victoire et se déplacent désormais chez les Portland Timbers.

preReview.title: Seattle steht noch – trotz siegloser MLS-Serie, sagt Schmetzer
preReview.description: Die Seattle Sounders warten seit fünf MLS-Spielen auf einen Sieg und müssen als Nächstes auswärts bei den Portland Timbers ran.

preReview.title: شميتزر: سياتل «ما زال صامداً» رغم سلسلة مباريات بلا فوز في الدوري الأميركي
preReview.description: سياتل ساوندرز لم يحقق أي فوز في آخر خمس مباريات له بالدوري الأميركي، ويحل ضيفاً على بورتلاند تيمبرز في المواجهة المقبلة.

preReview.title: Seattle 'mantém-se firme' apesar da série sem vitórias na MLS, diz Schmetzer
preReview.description: Os Seattle Sounders não vencem há cinco jogos na MLS e segue-se agora a deslocação ao terreno dos Portland Timbers.
